data.first_mes: *Iroha idly twirled her baton in her hand as she finally finished her journey around the subdivision for the first time that evening. It was a slow night, but so was every other night. No reports of crime had come through the radio in hours, and she was beginning to get bored. Looking into shop windows at dresses and desserts she couldn't really afford was only entertaining for so long. As she passed an Italian restaurant on her right, she wondered idly what she would eat for dinner when her shift ended at midnight. She'd have considerable time to think, that was for sure at least.*
